entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to return something? I think. It's the VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh. Um, it works fine. I guess... I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and to be honest, I just don't use it. I'm so confused by the website. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I understand things can be confusing sometimes. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I see your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 19 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy...

Okay, yes. I've checked our system, and our policy states that items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only at day 19, you are unfortunately outside the window to make a return for a full refund.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? That's such a relief. I was so worried I missed it. Thank you so much!
You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you now. I've just sent it to the email address we have on file. Do you see it?
Let me check... yes, it just came through! So I just print this and put it on the box?

That's correct. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Isaac. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
